book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas nukan Ämän Eposek Jon nukas jer wewon Jon Jisas nukan Ämän Eposek Jon nukas jer wewon

content: Jisas kon tamareäu roat sarwaraun mesin Anut auruwon.

Jisas kiro ämän kon tamareäu roat aware kureanik, omar oik eisane aparmara, Anut aurmoi, äiewon, “Moni, omre rusapai peu, nan mokoin enip jou orip kämioik mur, keserta, mokois nais nan enmat jou kämioik musai.
Na okoro roasiret erekapu kamwaraun sakau ko nurumon keseria, nakas roasiret ko nurumon kos awau orip orip rawaun sakau arai.
Awau orip orip rawaun onoktapau kiro, naka Jisas Krais pak äpu matoi. Na karar, na Anut, nas Jisas Krais äsimorta, kowon äpu moin.
Is okoro omnokou pakan roasiret nan sakau enmat jou orip pak ätär maromin. Is nas nan sarau maun äsimoiromon kiro erekapu patarmin.
Moni, meter okoro omnokou päu wa opok, is na pak raianik, enim jou orip raimin. Rusapai nan amun opok kiro enip jou orip ätäi irota, is na pak rawam.
Is nakasar okoro omnokou pakan roasiret sare mareanik, is iromon, nan sakau ätär maromin. Meter kiro roasiret nan sare maromon rain, nas is irota, akas nan ämän tainoriäi.
Ak rusapai äpu moin osap erekapu is iromon, kiro naka pakas kowon.
Nan ämän airomon, erekapu awaroita oin. Ak äpu kiro epar is na pak raiminus, koimin. Nas äsimoirta, koimin mesin akan woiaka epar marou.
Is ak mesin na aisom, is okoro omnokou pakan roasiret mesin aisau wa. Utianik, okoro roasiret nakasar is iromon mesin aisom, owon, kiro roasiret nan.
Isan roasiret kiro nan, nan roasiret kiro isan. Karauk roasiret ak isan roasiret akan onok aparianik, ak äpu maiei isan enim jou orip.

Is okoro omnokou opok ekep wa rawam. Rusapai is na rawa tonram, utianik, ak okoro omnokou opok rawaiei. O moni, nan onok eposek senes, nas kiro roasiret kamwareanik, nakan sakau is iromon kiro sakaus, ak sakau marota, rawaiei. Keseria, iwaka woiok karar raumur senek, ak nais woiaka karar me rawaiei.

Is ak pak raianik, kiro sakau nas is iromon pakaima kamwareäim. Is jekur kamwaromin, kar ro wasaräu wa. Kiro tamareäim ro karar Anut nukas ko oikuräun apu raunuk rai, ko oikuräi. Kiro nan ämän meter äiemon epar peu.
Is rusapai na raum opok tonaurim. Okoro omnokou opok, is kiro ämän ak rowaun äiem, owon, isan woi erekapu ereriäu senek kiro akan woiaka uru nais keseriar ereraiei.
Is nakas ämän iromon awaromin. Kiro mesin okoro omnokou pakan roasiret akas ak sauk maroin. Owon, is okoro omnokou pakan wa. Isan roasiret ak nais okoro omnokou pakan wa.
Is na ak okoro omnokou pakan imware oik tonaun aisau wa, na ak sarwaraun mesin is aisom. Keserta, ro aru Satan nukas ak wa aru marai.
Is okoro omnokou pakan wa, okon, ak nais okoro omnokou pakan wa.
Nan ämän erekapu epar senes. Nakasar nan epar ämänis akan woiaka uru sakau maronuk, ak nan roasiret tuku saräiei.
Nas is okoro omnokou opok roasiret kamuk opok äsimoirta, koimin senek, isas nais ak okoro omnokou pakan roasiret kamuk äsimwaromin.
Is ak sarwaraun isan enimsau na isom. Keserita, ak nan roasiret tuku senes rawaiei.
Is ak mesin karar aisau wa, inok roasiret isan tamareäim roat akas kiro ämän awarona, roumoi, akan woiaka epar morai ak nais sarwaraun mesin na aisom.

Isan ronkat okoro roasiret erekapu akan woiaka karar me rawaiei. Moni, naka is pak rauta, is nais na pak raim senek keseraiei. Keseria, ak iu pak rawaun is aisom. Keserna, okoro omnokou pakan roasiret akas nas is äsimoirta, koimin mesin akan woiaka epar maiei.
Nas is kiro enip jou iromon senek, isas nais ak enmaka jou aromin, okon, iu karar raumur senek ak nais woiaka karar me rawaiei.

Is ak pak pasar raim senek na is pak pasar raum. Keseria, okoro omnokou pakan roasiret äpu maiei, nakasar is äsimoiromoi, na nan won is mesin meieäum senek, na nais isan roasiret akanun wonas keseriar meieäum.

O moni, nakasar kiro roasiret is iromon is na aisom, is tone rawam opok ak nais is pak erek tone rawaiei. Keseria, meter okoro omnokou ate mau wa opok, nas nan wonas isanun meieanik, kiro enim jou iromon ak aparaiei.
O moni, na onok eposek miämon ro, okoro omnokou pakan roasiret ak na äpu musau wa. Okoro roasiret nas is äsimoiromon äpu miäi, ak karar epar is pakas na äpu musoi.
Isas nan enmat ak opok amop musomin ätäiar amop musam. Keserita, naka is mesin wonas meieäum senek, akas nais karauk roat mesin akan woiakas meiena, is ak pak rawam.”
